verdict.rationale: Buzz ships a Desktop-bundled managed agent and its own agent runtime (buzz-agent). Users hand work to agents by @mentioning them in channels; the harness prompts the agent, and the agent acts through the Buzz CLI (repos, patches, workflows, canvases, channels). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works well in practice, and clear documentation of whether the built-in agent works out of the box or needs the user to configure an LLM provider.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Desktop-bundled managed agent ships a packaged skill
The harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts your agent, and the agent replies using the Buzz CLI.
open repos, send patches, review code, run workflows, edit canvases, orchestrate other agents
